an10.14:1.1: cetasovinibandhā asamucchinnā → cetaso vinibandhā asamucchinanā (sya-all) | vuddhi → vuḍḍhi (sya-all)
an10.14:4.1: pañca cetasovinibandhā asamucchinnā → pañcacetaso vinibandhā asamucchinno (bj)
an10.14:5.6: cetasovinibandho asamucchinno hoti → cetaso vinibandhā asamucchinnā honti (bj)
an10.14:7.2: evamevaṁ → emameva (bj); evameva (sya-all) | vuddhi yassa kassaci → vuḍḍhi yassakassaci (sya-all)
an10.14:8.1: cetasovinibandhā susamucchinnā → cetaso vinibandhā samucchinnā (bj, sya-all) | vuddhiyeva → vuḍḍhiyeva (sya-all) | samucchinnā → susamucchinnā (bj: machasaṁ)
an10.14:14.2: evamevaṁ → evameva (bj, sya-all) | pañca cetasovinibandhā susamucchinnā → pañcacetaso vinibandhā susamucchinno (bj) | vuddhiyeva → vuḍḍhiyeva (sya-all)
